py: zhè ge yào kǔ bù kǔ
en: Is this medicine bitter?
why: An adjective makes its A-not-A question with 不 between the two copies. 没 negates 有 or a past event, and 吗 would add a second question marker.

py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu fā shāo
en: Do you have a fever?
why: 有 is negated only by 没, so its A-not-A form is 有没有. 有不有 does not exist, and 吗 cannot sit between the two 有.

py: nǐ xiǎng bù xiǎng qù yī yuàn kàn kan
en: Do you want to go and get checked at the hospital?
why: The modal 想 is the word that doubles: 想不想 + verb. 没 would negate a past event, and 吗 inside the verb phrase is not possible.

py: nǐ men dōu xǐ huan dōng tiān ma
en: Do you all like winter?
why: After 都 only 吗 can mark the question; A-not-A cannot follow 都. 不喜欢 would turn the sentence into a statement.

py: nǐ shì bù shì duì huā fěn guò mǐn
en: Are you allergic to pollen?
why: 是不是 placed before the predicate asks about a guess. 没 does not negate 是, and 吗 cannot be squeezed between the two 是.

py: míng tiān huì bù huì xià xuě
en: Will it snow tomorrow?
why: The modal 会 is doubled with 不: 会不会 + verb. 没会 does not exist, and 吗 in the middle would not form a question.

py: nǐ hē rè shuǐ hái shi liáng shuǐ
en: Do you want hot water or cold water?
why: An either/or question that makes the listener choose uses 还是. 或者 is the 'or' of statements, and 和 means 'and'.

q: 不舒服的时候，你可以吃点药___睡一觉。
zh: 不舒服的时候，你可以吃点药或者睡一觉。
py: bù shū fu de shí hou nǐ kě yǐ chī diǎn yào huò zhě shuì yī jiào
en: When you feel unwell, you can take some medicine or get some sleep.
why: This is a statement listing two options, so it takes 或者. 还是 is reserved for questions that ask the listener to choose, and 而且 would add rather than offer alternatives.

q: 夏天你想去海边___去山里？
zh: 夏天你想去海边还是去山里？
py: xià tiān nǐ xiǎng qù hǎi biān hái shi qù shān lǐ
en: In summer, do you want to go to the seaside or to the mountains?
why: The sentence asks which one the listener prefers, so 还是 joins the two options. 或者 cannot be used in a question like this.

q: 我不知道明天会下雨___下雪。
zh: 我不知道明天会下雨还是下雪。
py: wǒ bù zhī dào míng tiān huì xià yǔ hái shi xià xuě
en: I don't know whether it will rain or snow tomorrow.
why: An unknown choice inside 'I don't know…' still uses 还是. 或者 would say 'rain or snow' as a list of possibilities, and 吗 cannot be added.

py: nǐ nǎ r téng
en: Where does it hurt?
why: The question word sits where the answer would go: 头疼 / 肚子疼 are places, so 哪儿. 什么 would ask 'what hurts' in a different structure.

py: nǐ shén me shí hou kě yǐ chū yuàn
en: When can you leave the hospital?
why: 'When' is 什么时候, which sits before the verb like any time word. 哪 needs a measure word and 谁 asks who.

q: 你要哪___药，红的还是白的？
zh: 你要哪个药，红的还是白的？
py: nǐ yào nǎ ge yào hóng de hái shi bái de
en: Which medicine do you want, the red one or the white one?
why: Choosing one item from known options takes 哪 + a measure word, and 个 is the general one for 药 here. 位 is only used for people and 本 for books, so neither fits medicine.

py: zhè bǎ sǎn shì shéi de
en: Whose umbrella is this?
why: Owner is asked with 谁的. 什么的 and a bare 哪的 do not ask who owns something.

q: 你觉得这个城市___个季节最舒服？
zh: 你觉得这个城市哪个季节最舒服？
py: nǐ jué de zhè ge chéng shì nǎ ge jì jié zuì shū fu
en: Which season do you think is the most comfortable in this city?
why: With the measure word 个 already present, the choosing word is 哪: 哪个季节. 什么 does not take a measure word in this way.

zh: 今天医院来了多少病人？
py: jīn tiān yī yuàn lái le duō shao bìng rén
en: How many patients came to the hospital today?
why: With no measure word before the noun, only 多少 works. 几 must be followed by a measure word, and 多 alone does not mean 'how many'.

py: zhè píng shuǐ duō shao qián
en: How much is this bottle of water?
why: The price question is the fixed phrase 多少钱. 几钱 is not used, and 多钱 is not a question phrase.

py: nǐ nǚ ér jīn nián jǐ suì le
en: How old is your daughter this year?
why: A child's age is asked with 几岁. 几年 would ask how many years, and 个 is not the measure word for age.

q: 春天一般从___月开始变暖？
zh: 春天一般从几月开始变暖？
py: chūn tiān yī bān cóng jǐ yuè kāi shǐ biàn nuǎn
en: Which month does spring usually start to warm up from?
why: Months are asked with the fixed form 几月. 多少月 is never said, and 哪月 lacks the measure word that 哪 needs.

py: zhè zhǒng yào zěn me chī
en: How do you take this medicine?
why: 'How to do it' is 怎么 right before the verb. 怎么样 is a predicate on its own, and 为什么 would ask for a reason.

q: 你___还没吃药？你中午说过要吃的。
zh: 你怎么还没吃药？你中午说过要吃的。
py: nǐ zěn me hái méi chī yào nǐ zhōng wǔ shuō guo yào chī de
en: How come you still haven't taken your medicine? You said you would at noon.
why: 怎么 before 还没 means 'how come' and carries surprise. 怎么样 cannot sit before a verb phrase like this.

py: nǐ zěn me le liǎn sè bù tài hǎo
en: What's wrong with you? You don't look well.
why: 你怎么了 is the fixed way to ask what is wrong. 你怎么样了 would ask how you are now, which does not fit the cue.

py: qǐng wèn qù yī yuàn zěn me zǒu
en: Excuse me, how do I get to the hospital?
why: Asking the way to do something puts 怎么 before the verb 走. 怎么样 would ask what it is like, and 为什么 would ask why.

zh: 你怎么知道我今天要出院？
py: nǐ zěn me zhī dào wǒ jīn tiān yào chū yuàn
en: How did you know I'm leaving hospital today?
why: The cue asks 'how did you know', the way or source, so 怎么 + verb. 为什么 would ask why you know, and 怎么样 cannot precede a verb.

q: 秋天去北京旅游，你觉得___？
zh: 秋天去北京旅游，你觉得怎么样？
py: qiū tiān qù běi jīng lǚ yóu nǐ jué de zěn me yàng
en: How about travelling to Beijing in autumn?
why: 你觉得 + 怎么样 asks for an opinion at the end of a sentence. 怎么 needs a verb after it, and 为什么 asks for a reason.

py: nǐ jīn nián duō dà le
en: How old are you this year?
why: Age is asked with 多 + 大. 几大 is not a phrase, and 很 makes a statement, not a question.

py: yī yuàn lí zhè r yǒu duō yuǎn
en: How far is the hospital from here?
why: 'How far' is 多远, with optional 有 before it. 很远 is a statement, and 怎么远 is not a question about distance.

py: nǐ fā shāo duō cháng shí jiān le
en: How long have you had a fever?
why: Duration is asked with 多长时间. 几 and 多少 cannot be put in front of 长时间.

q: 这条河冬天结冰以后，冰有___厚？
zh: 这条河冬天结冰以后，冰有多厚？
py: zhè tiáo hé dōng tiān jié bīng yǐ hòu bīng yǒu duō hòu
en: How thick is the ice once the river freezes in winter?
why: 'How thick' is 多厚, with 有 allowed before it. 怎么厚 and 多少厚 do not ask about a measurement.

q: 你这样一天要睡___久才够？
zh: 你这样一天要睡多久才够？
py: nǐ zhè yàng yī tiān yào shuì duō jiǔ cái gòu
en: How long do you have to sleep a day to get enough?
why: 'How long' in time is 多久 (= 多长时间). 怎么久 and 几久 are not used.

py: wǒ men míng tiān qù pá shān hǎo ma
en: We're going hiking tomorrow, shall we?
why: A suggestion that asks for agreement takes 好吗. 对吗 and 是吗 check whether a fact is true, which does not fit 'shall we'.

py: nǐ shì yī shēng duì bù duì
en: You're a doctor, right?
why: The speaker is checking a fact, so the tag is 对不对. 好吗 and 行吗 ask someone to agree to a proposal.

py: nǐ zuó wǎn méi shuì hǎo shì bù shì
en: You didn't sleep well last night, did you?
why: Checking a negative fact takes 是不是, with no change for the 没. 好不好 and 行吗 ask for agreement to a plan.

py: nǐ zài kàn shén me ne
en: What are you looking at?
why: A question-word question may end in 呢 to sound curious. 吗 cannot be added to a question word question, and 了 is not a question particle.

zh: 你怎么还不去看医生呢？
py: nǐ zěn me hái bù qù kàn yī shēng ne
en: How come you still haven't gone to see a doctor?
why: The sentence already has 怎么, so only the softening 呢 may finish it. 吗 would add a second question marker.

py: wǒ jīn tiān shén me dōu bù xiǎng chī
en: I don't feel like eating anything today.
why: 什么 before 都 + 不 means 'nothing at all'. 吗 would turn it into a question, and 要 does not make 什么 mean 'anything'.

zh: 他病了，一天什么都没吃。
py: tā bìng le yī tiān shén me dōu méi chī
en: He was ill and ate nothing all day.
why: 什么 + 都 + 没 means 'nothing at all'. Without 都 the sentence would read as a question or be incomplete.

q: 这件事___都知道，你不用问了。
zh: 这件事谁都知道，你不用问了。
py: zhè jiàn shì shéi dōu zhī dào nǐ bù yòng wèn le
en: Everyone knows about this, so you needn't ask.
why: 谁 + 都 means 'everyone'. 哪 needs a measure word and 什么 would mean 'everything', not 'everyone'.

q: 医生说我身体很好，没___问题。
zh: 医生说我身体很好，没什么问题。
py: yī shēng shuō wǒ shēn tǐ hěn hǎo méi shén me wèn tí
en: The doctor said I'm in good health, with nothing much wrong.
why: 没什么 + noun means 'no particular problem'. 哪儿 and 谁 cannot modify 问题 in this way.

q: 雪下得太大了，我们___也去不了。
zh: 雪下得太大了，我们哪儿也去不了。
py: xuě xià de tài dà le wǒ men nǎ r yě qù bù liǎo
en: The snow was so heavy that we couldn't go anywhere.
why: The cue is 'go anywhere', so 哪儿 + 也 + a negative. 什么 would mean 'nothing', and 谁 would mean 'nobody'.

q: 这个病的名字太难了，___都记不住。
zh: 这个病的名字太难了，谁都记不住。
py: zhè ge bìng de míng zi tài nán le shéi dōu jì bu zhù
en: The name of this illness is so hard that nobody can remember it.
why: 谁 before 都 and a negative means 'nobody'. 哪里 would mean 'nowhere', and 怎么 cannot take 都 in this way.

q: 你___说你感冒了吗？怎么还去游泳？
zh: 你不是说你感冒了吗？怎么还去游泳？
py: nǐ bù shì shuō nǐ gǎn mào le ma zěn me hái qù yóu yǒng
en: Didn't you say you had a cold? How come you're still going swimming?
why: 不是 … 吗 reminds the listener of what they said, with surprise at the contradiction. 是不是 would be a second question marker with 吗.

q: 昨天天气预报___说今天是晴天吗？怎么下雨了？
zh: 昨天天气预报不是说今天是晴天吗？怎么下雨了？
py: zuó tiān tiān qì yù bào bù shì shuō jīn tiān shì qíng tiān ma zěn me xià yǔ le
en: Didn't the forecast say yesterday that today would be sunny? How come it's raining?
why: The speaker remembers the forecast and is surprised by the rain, so 不是 follows the subject and 吗 closes the sentence. 是不是 together with 吗 would be a double question marker.

q: 你不是对海鲜过敏___？怎么还吃虾？
zh: 你不是对海鲜过敏吗？怎么还吃虾？
py: nǐ bù shì duì hǎi xiān guò mǐn ma zěn me hái chī xiā
en: Aren't you allergic to seafood? Why are you still eating shrimp?
why: The rhetorical frame 不是 … 吗 needs 吗 at the end. 呢 and 了 cannot close it.

q: 他不是上个月就出院___吗？
zh: 他不是上个月就出院了吗？
py: tā bù shì shàng ge yuè jiù chū yuàn le ma
en: Didn't he leave hospital last month already?
why: Between 不是 and 吗 the sentence keeps its own aspect, and 就 … 了 marks something already done. 过 and 着 do not fit the 'already' idea.

py: nǐ tóu téng bù téng
en: Does your head hurt?
why: The A-not-A form ends the sentence in place, with no 吗.

py: nǐ xiǎng bù xiǎng qù kàn yī shēng
en: Do you want to go and see a doctor?
why: The modal 想 is doubled before the main verb 去.

py: nǐ men yě xǐ huan qiū tiān ma
en: Do you like autumn too?
why: After 也 the question is marked with 吗 at the end; A-not-A is not possible after 也.

py: nǐ chī yào hái shi dǎ zhēn
en: Will you take medicine or have an injection?
why: 还是 stands between the two options and no 吗 follows.

py: nǐ shì gǎn mào hái shi fā shāo
en: Do you have a cold or a fever?
why: 还是 joins the two parallel options and 吗 is left out.

py: míng tiān shì qíng tiān hái shi yīn tiān
en: Is tomorrow going to be sunny or cloudy?
why: 还是 sits between the two parallel predicates and the question needs no 吗.

py: nǐ nǎ r bù shū fu
en: Where do you feel unwell?
why: 哪儿 stays in the slot where the answer (the body part) would go, before the predicate.

py: nǐ shén me shí hou qù yī yuàn
en: When are you going to the hospital?
why: 什么时候 is a time word and goes before the verb, not at the end.

py: nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ ge jì jié
en: Which season do you like best?
why: 哪个 stays in the object slot, right before the noun it asks about.

py: nǐ yī tiān chī jǐ cì yào
en: How many times a day do you take medicine?
why: 几 comes with its measure word (几次) and the question word stays before the noun.

py: zhè bǎ sǎn yào duō shao qián
en: How much is this umbrella?
why: The price is asked with 多少钱 at the end.

zh: 你们那儿几月开始下雪？
py: nǐ men nà r jǐ yuè kāi shǐ xià xuě
en: In which month does it start snowing where you are?
why: 几月 is a time phrase before the verb, and it needs no extra 吗.

py: nǐ zěn me hái méi shuì jiào
en: How come you still haven't gone to sleep?
why: 怎么 comes before 还没 and shows surprise.

py: nǐ wèi shén me bù xiǎng qù yī yuàn
en: Why don't you want to go to the hospital?
why: 为什么 goes before the negated verb phrase, like any adverbial.

py: nǐ ér zi duō dà le
en: How old is your son?
why: Age is asked with 多大 and the sentence-final 了.

py: nǐ měi tiān shuì duō cháng shí jiān
en: How long do you sleep every day?
why: 多长时间 closes the question after the verb as the duration.

py: nǐ jiā lí gōng yuán yǒu duō yuǎn
en: How far is your home from the park?
why: 有 + 多远 gives the distance after the 离 phrase.

py: wǒ men zhōu mò qù pá shān hǎo ma
en: Shall we go hiking at the weekend?
why: The suggestion comes first and 好吗 is added at the end as a tag.

py: nǐ zài chī shén me yào ne
en: What medicine are you taking?
why: 呢 ends a question-word question softly, after the whole sentence.

zh: 你明天不用上班是不是？
py: nǐ míng tiān bù yòng shàng bān shì bù shì
en: You don't have to work tomorrow, do you?
why: 是不是 can close the sentence as a tag that checks a fact, or sit before the predicate; both orders ask the same thing, and 吗 is not added.

py: wǒ nǎ r yě bù xiǎng qù
en: I don't want to go anywhere.
why: 哪儿 comes before 也 and 不, so the object-like place is placed before the verb.

py: zhè ge bìng shéi yě zhì bù liǎo
en: Nobody can cure this illness.
why: 谁 + 也 means 'nobody' and stays before the negative verb.

py: nǐ bù shì shuō míng tiān xià yǔ ma
en: Didn't you say it would rain tomorrow?
why: 不是 follows the subject and 吗 closes the sentence.

py: tā bù shì yǐ jīng chū yuàn le ma
en: Hasn't he already left hospital?
why: The middle part keeps 已经 … 了, with 不是 at the start and 吗 at the end.

py: nǐ bù shì bù xǐ huan dōng tiān ma
en: Don't you dislike winter?
why: 不是 … 吗 wraps the speaker's belief, and the inner 不 stays in the middle.

zh: 他今天去医院还是回家？
py: tā jīn tiān qù yī yuàn hái shi huí jiā
en: Is he going to the hospital or going home today?
why: A question that asks which of two options uses 还是. 或者 is only for statements.

s_py: nǐ xiǎng chī yào hái shi dǎ zhēn ma
py: nǐ xiǎng chī yào hái shi dǎ zhēn
en: Do you want to take medicine or have an injection?
why: 还是 already makes this a choice question, so adding 吗 doubles the question marker. It must end after 打针.

s_py: zhè ge yī yuàn yǒu jǐ yī shēng
py: zhè ge yī yuàn yǒu duō shao yī shēng
en: How many doctors does this hospital have?
why: 几 needs a measure word right after it, which is missing here. 多少 can stand directly before the noun.

s_py: jīn tiān de tiān qì zěn me
py: jīn tiān de tiān qì zěn me yàng
en: How is the weather today?
why: 'What is it like' needs 怎么样. 怎么 alone needs a verb after it and cannot end a sentence.

s_py: cóng zhè r dào yī yuàn zěn me yuǎn
py: cóng zhè r dào yī yuàn yǒu duō yuǎn
en: How far is it from here to the hospital?
why: Distance is asked with 多远. 怎么 + adjective does not mean 'how far'.

s_py: wǒ bù xiǎng chī shén me dōu
py: wǒ shén me dōu bù xiǎng chī
en: I don't want to eat anything.
why: The question word must come before 都, so 什么 moves in front of the verb and 不.

s_py: wǒ men qù pá shān hǎo bù hǎo ma
py: wǒ men qù pá shān hǎo bù hǎo
en: Shall we go hiking?
why: 好不好 is already the tag question, so adding 吗 doubles the question marker.

s_py: nǐ xǐ huan nǎ jì jié
py: nǐ xǐ huan nǎ ge jì jié
en: Which season do you like?
why: 哪 must be followed by a measure word, here 个, before the noun.
